legend: You are given an integer $N$. Print an upside-down right triangle of stars with $N$ rows: the first row has $N$ stars and each next row has one star fewer.
input: One line with an integer $N$ ($1 \le N \le 99$).
output: Print the triangle, as in the example.
notes: Do not print spaces after the last \texttt{*} of a line.
